_meta.timezone_note: close_et is U.S. Eastern Standard Time (UTC-5). Values 00:00/01:00 fall on Nov 4 ET. close_utc is unambiguous.

AK.notes: 8 p.m. local. Mainland Alaska (AKST) = 00:00 ET Nov 4; Aleutian precincts on Hawaii-Aleutian time = 01:00 ET Nov 4 (last close).

AL.notes: 7 p.m. CT statewide (20:00 ET); the few Eastern-time localities close 7 p.m. ET (19:00 ET).

AZ.notes: 7 p.m. MST (Arizona does not observe DST) = 21:00 ET.

CA.notes: 8 p.m. PT. Largely vote-by-mail; ballots postmarked by election day count if received within 7 days.

FL.notes: 7 p.m. local: peninsula (ET) closes 19:00 ET; panhandle (CT) closes 20:00 ET (last close). Statewide results are typically withheld until 20:00 ET.

HI.notes: 7 p.m. HST = 00:00 ET Nov 4. Largely vote-by-mail.

ID.notes: 8 p.m. local: southern Idaho (MT) = 22:00 ET; northern panhandle (PT) = 23:00 ET (last close).

IN.notes: 6 p.m. local: most of state (ET) = 18:00 ET; northwest/southwest counties (CT) = 19:00 ET (last close).

KS.notes: 7 p.m. local: most of state (CT) = 20:00 ET; four western counties (MT) = 21:00 ET (last close). Counties may stay open until 8 p.m. CT.

KY.notes: 6 p.m. local: eastern Kentucky (ET) = 18:00 ET; western Kentucky (CT) = 19:00 ET (last close).

ME.notes: 8 p.m. ET. Ranked-choice voting used for federal general elections.

MI.notes: 8 p.m. local: Lower Peninsula and most of Upper Peninsula (ET) = 20:00 ET; four western UP counties (CT) = 21:00 ET (last close).

ND.notes: Counties set hours; polls close between 7 and 9 p.m. local. Most close 7 p.m. local (20:00 ET Central / 21:00 ET Mountain). Statutory latest possible close is 9 p.m. MT (23:00 ET).

NE.notes: 8 p.m. CT / 7 p.m. MT = 21:00 ET statewide.

NH.notes: Set by municipality; no earlier than 7 p.m. ET. Most towns close 7 p.m.; largest cities 8 p.m. (last close 20:00 ET).

OR.notes: 8 p.m. local: most of state (PT) = 23:00 ET; Malheur County (MT) = 22:00 ET. All-mail state.

SD.notes: 7 p.m. local: eastern SD (CT) = 20:00 ET; western SD (MT) = 21:00 ET (last close).

TN.notes: 8 p.m. ET in East Tennessee / 7 p.m. CT in Middle and West Tennessee = 20:00 ET statewide.

TX.notes: 7 p.m. local: most of state (CT) = 20:00 ET; El Paso and Hudspeth counties (MT) = 21:00 ET (last close).
